messageExportPolicy: Only a selected non-empty COMPLETE assistant reply in the active role/space/chat can be frozen. The approved immutable UTF-8 bytes are written directly to the user-selected system URI, then reopened and compared byte-for-byte; no public-directory or cache copy is created.
limitations: Static APK marker scan. Device database, WAL, cache, Keystore files, Storage Access Framework behavior, SQLCipher upgrade and live provider requests require a connected device or controlled endpoint.
